wheel:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent source sprite for a Pokémon Crystal style Minnesota State Fairgrounds tileset.
Primary request: A beautiful, immediately recognizable fairground Ferris wheel landmark, composed for a top-down 2000 Game Boy Color RPG environment. One static wheel only, no people, no scene.
Style: authentic low-resolution pixel art with chunky clean stepped pixel clusters and flat limited colors; ALL artwork aligned to an EXACT 64 by 64 logical pixel canvas, enlarged exactly 16 times to a 1024 by 1024 PNG. Hard square pixels, no antialias, no gradients, no dither noise, no painted textures. The wheel should occupy logical x=5..58 and y=3..58, preserving a fully transparent outer border. Front-facing upright wheel as seen in Pokemon Crystal overworld perspective, slight top view of gondola roofs. A large circular golden rim with eight small brick-red gondolas, cream highlights, fine charcoal spokes, and a sturdy triangular red support with a tiny loading platform. Balanced readable silhouette, charming late summer midway mood. Background truly transparent, including openings between spokes. Native logical pixel size exactly 64x64: do not draw a detailed high-resolution illustration. Keep individual gondolas 5-7 logical pixels, rim 2 logical pixels thick, outline 1 logical pixel thick.
Palette: transparent + cream #fff3bd, warm gold #d69c42, deep brick red #a54a42, charcoal #393939. Use only these flat colors. No letters, labels, signage, ground, shadows on ground, grass, sky, framing or other objects. Intended to be split without rescaling into four adjacent 32x32 map blocks.
fair_food:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent 32x32 native tile sprite for a Pokémon Crystal style Minnesota State Fair food row.
Primary request: One adorable corn-roast and food-on-a-stick kiosk. Classic red-and-cream striped peaked awning with a small corn-cob pictogram at its crest, dark open service window, a little golden cob and corndog on the counter, squat timber base. No writing, no vendor character. Three-quarter overhead facade angle matching Pokémon Crystal houses, straight front facing south, no isometric rotation.
Style: authentic 2000 Game Boy Color overworld pixel art. EXACT 32 by 32 logical pixel canvas enlarged 32 times to a 1024x1024 PNG. Every visible pixel must be a hard square on that 32x32 grid. Keep object within logical columns3..28 and rows3..28 with transparent margin on ALL four sides. Bold simple chunky silhouette, stepped pixels, one-pixel charcoal outlines, clean broad color areas.
Palette: transparent plus ONLY warm cream #fff3bd, brick red #a54a42, charcoal #393939. Golden corn can use cream. Truly transparent background and openings, no ground, no grass, no dirt patch, no cast shadow, no lettering, no labels, no frame, no other objects, no smooth lines, no gradients, no antialiasing. Art should be immediately readable at the actual 32x32 size.
